item: fake sqlcipher3 no longer poisons the driver-class caches (row 188)
summary: test_email_ingest's fake-sqlcipher3 tests left write._db_operational_error_types cached without the real OperationalError, so a later real locked error read as not locked (order dependent). They clear the caches via a fixture; the teardown hook fails any test leaving a fake driver or a stale driver-class cache; an AST ratchet pins the cached list.
